discovery: Development of next-generation sequencing-by-synthesis (massively parallel DNA sequencing using reversible fluorescent terminators and clonal cluster amplification)
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes covered MOFs (2025), protein design and structure prediction (2024), and quantum dots (2023), so the committee may turn next to a chemistry-driven method with very wide impact on the life sciences. Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis rests on nucleotide chemistry and surface chemistry. It cut genome sequencing costs by about a millionfold and changed biology and medicine. The trio has already won major prizes (Breakthrough Prize 2022, Millennium Technology Prize 2020), which often comes before a Nobel.
